// PER-LINT EXCLUSION PROBE (no-raw-ci-verdict). This fixture's PATH matches the per-lint exclusion
// substring `myelin-flow/src/pg_executor.rs`, so ONLY `no-raw-ci-verdict` is suppressed here — every
// OTHER lint still scans this file. It deliberately carries BOTH:
//  (1) a `signal_typed` token that no-raw-ci-verdict WOULD flag (but is suppressed for this file), and
//  (2) a `no-host-exec` violation (`std::process::Command::new`) that MUST still fire.
// The gate self-test proves the file is NOT wholesale-skipped: the different lint trips, the
// suppressed one does not.
pub fn probe(executor: &Exec, spec: TypedSignalSpec) {
    let _ = executor.signal_typed(spec);
    let _ = std::process::Command::new("sh");
}
